name: helpcenter-io
description: Build and maintain your HelpCenter.io knowledge base: answers, articles, templates, and content insights.

interface.shortDescription: Build and manage a help center
interface.longDescription: Build and maintain your HelpCenter.io help center in conversation. Find answers in existing articles, draft documentation, stage edits for review, organize categories, and identify content gaps from analytics. Build or refine your help center’s visual template, branding, page layouts, navigation, and theme as a draft in the Template Editor. Review reader comments and private editorial notes when you grant the relevant permissions. Connect through OAuth and choose the help center and permissions to share; design access is separate from content access. Published changes and public replies take effect immediately. Keep content and template edits as drafts until you are ready to release them.
defaultPrompt: Find our getting started articles and summarize the steps with source links.
Create an unpublished help article from the product notes I provide.
Build a branded help center template as a draft for me to review before publishing.

publication.release_notes: Template building reworked: from a short brief, the plugin now designs and builds a complete branded help center theme as a draft (palette for light and dark mode, typography, page layouts, hero, category cards, header, footer, navigation and custom CSS) and checks contrast, mobile layout and empty states before handing it over for review. Article skills cover bulk import, images, the Trash, reordering and change sets. Nothing is published without the user's say-so.
